rule.statement: The finding of the District Court that the 3rd defendant has acquired prescriptive title to lots 1, 3 and 4 in plan X is justifiable.
rule.supporting_quote: On the facts and circumstances of this case, the finding of the District Court which was affirmed by the High Court that, on a balance of probability, the 3rd defendant has acquired prescriptive title to lots 1, 3 and 4 in plan X, is justifiable.
